Melvin Manhoef, also known as “No Mercy,” is a Dutch professional mixed martial artist and kickboxer. He was born on May 11, 1976, in Paramaribo, Suriname, but moved to the Netherlands at a young age. Manhoef has competed in organizations such as Bellator MMA, Strikeforce, ONE Championship, and K-1.

Manhoef is known for his aggressive fighting style and knockout power, with the majority of his wins coming by way of knockout. He has fought in multiple weight classes throughout his career, including middleweight, light heavyweight, and heavyweight.

In kickboxing, Manhoef is a former It's Showtime champion and has faced some of the biggest names in the sport, including Badr Hari and Remy Bonjasky. In MMA, he has notable wins over fighters such as Mark Hunt, Kazushi Sakuraba, Robbie Lawler, and Evangelista Santos.

Despite his success in combat sports, Manhoef has also faced challenges in his career, including testing positive for performance-enhancing drugs in 2009. He has since returned to competition and continues to be a fan-favorite for his exciting fighting style.

Overall, Melvin Manhoef is considered a legend in both kickboxing and MMA, known for his devastating striking abilities and never-say-die attitude inside the cage or ring.
